description.narrative: The overall objective of the Project is Strengthening the Colombian Police to become a more transparent, responsive and civilian-oriented police organisation. The Authority Cooperation shall contribute to ensuring a safer and more open and transparent society for citizens in Colombia, with a high level of trust in the Colombian police.

Detta är ett projektstöd för kapacitetsutveckling av den colombianska polisen, via teknisk assistans från den svenska polismyndigheten. Projektet syftar till att bidra till att stärka den colombianska polisen till att bli en mer transparent, lyhörd och civilt orienterad polisorganisation. Bidraget är en fortsättning på samarbetet mellan polismyndigheterna som startade 2013. Tidigare bidrags ID-nummer är: 52060048, 11444 och 16542.

This is a project support for capacity development of the Colombian Police, via technical assistance provided by the Swedish Police Authority. The project aims to contribute to strengthening the Colombian Police to become a more transparent, responsive, and civilian-oriented police organisation. The contribution is a continuation of the cooperation between the police authorities which started in 2013. Previous contribution ID-numbers are: 52060048, 11444 and 16542.
